review_candidates.title: Information Technology Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description FETRA INTEGRITY Egypt & Project Management is a human capital consulting and business development company focused on enhancing organizational performance through tailored people strategies. The organization provides end-to-end HR and project management services, including recruitment, organization design and restructuring, job analysis, competency modeling, and total reward management. FETRA also supports clients with performance management, succession planning, learning and development, and comprehensive payroll and insurance services. Through bespoke models and data-driven analysis such as training needs and ROI assessments, FETRA helps organizations align resources with strategic goals and achieve optimal efficiency. The company emphasizes high-quality, customized solutions that strengthen workforce capability and organizational resilience. Role Description The Information Technology Manager will lead and oversee all IT operations on-site at FETRA INTEGRITY Egypt & Project Management in Ain Sokhna in a full-time capacity. This role includes managing IT infrastructure, networks, servers, and hardware, ensuring system reliability, security, and availability to support HR, project management, and business development activities. The manager will plan and implement technology solutions, supervise IT staff and vendors, manage backups and disaster recovery, and maintain compliance with relevant security and data protection standards. Daily tasks involve troubleshooting technical issues, monitoring system performance, coordinating software implementations and upgrades, and supporting end users with timely IT assistance. The role also includes collaborating with leadership to align IT strategy with business objectives, preparing budgets and reports, and recommending improvements to optimize digital workflows and organizational performance. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in IT infrastructure management, including servers, networks, operating systems, and endpoint devices. Candidates should possess skills in information security, data protection, backup, and disaster recovery planning to ensure business continuity. Candidates should possess skills in systems administration and application support, including implementing, configuring, and maintaining business and HR-related software. Candidates should possess skills in IT project management, including planning, resource coordination, and delivery of technology initiatives on time and within budget. Candidates should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues and implement effective solutions. Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders at all levels. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, along with relevant professional certifications (e.g., CCNA, Microsoft, ITIL) as an advantage. Prior experience managing IT operations in a corporate or consulting environment, and familiarity with HR or project management systems, is highly beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Senior Python Developer
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Senior Python Software Engineer with at least 5 years of professional experience developing backend applications using Python to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help design, build, maintain, and evolve scalable backend services that power our platform. You will be responsible for implementing high-quality software solutions, optimizing application performance, and contributing to the architecture and long-term evolution of our systems. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will participate in technical design discussions, mentor fellow engineers, and promote engineering best practices. This role requires deep technical expertise in Python, Django, distributed systems, and modern software engineering principles. Tasks Design, develop, and implement new functionality for decoupled backend services. Maintain, enhance, and refactor existing backend applications to improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Analyze and optimize application performance, database queries, and overall system efficiency. Take ownership of backend services throughout their lifecycle, including architecture, deployment, production support, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Participate actively in technical design discussions, solution architecture, and project planning sessions. Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions. Review code, provide constructive feedback, and champion engineering best practices through peer collaboration. Mentor and support other team members by sharing technical expertise and assisting with complex engineering challenges. Troubleshoot production issues using profiling, monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools. Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and design specifications. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to the engineering stack where appropriate. Effectively utilize AI-powered development tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex) to accelerate software development while ensuring code quality, correctness, security, and maintainability. Requirements At least 5 years of professional experience developing backend applications with Python . Strong commercial experience building web applications using Django and the Django ORM. Solid experience working with relational databases, particularly MySQL . Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs , GraphQL , or similar service interfaces. Experience working with distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies such as Celery . Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, clean architecture, and distributed system design. Experience using Git-based version control workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews. Experience writing technical documentation and software design specifications. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills using profiling tools, SQL execution plans, application monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic), and related technologies. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical solutions, prioritize tasks effectively, and proactively resolve issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to participate in technical discussions and mentor other engineers. Preferred Qualifications Experience with supporting technologies such as Redis , Memcached , Elasticsearch , and Celery . Experience building, deploying, and operating cloud-native or highly scalable backend services. Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex) for code generation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and code review while applying sound engineering judgment to validate and improve generated output. Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers and contributing to engineering standards and best practices. Benefits All employees benefits for free (our famous games room, daily breakfast, fruits, coffee and other hot drinks, soft drinks and juices, company days out and parties…) Social insurance Open-door management policy Full Medical insurance Accommodation and Transportation Allowance Friendly environment that values innovation and efficiency Exciting opportunities for career growth and talent development Feedback encouragement Recognition and reward programs Competitive salaries and incentives Friendly environment Flexible and Comfortable schedule Fun committees Monetary rewards Fun, smart and creative people Career possibilities with growing team Paid vacations Social benefits
